snippet.title: REANIMAL | Collector's Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a first look of the REANIMAL Collector's Edition.
You can Pre-Order it here: 
US Store: https://us.reanimalstore.com/
EU Store: https://eu.reanimalstore.com/

The Collector's Edition includes:
- The Game
- Season Pass + Pre-Order DLC
- Artbook
- Exclusive Box
- PVC Statue "Pig"
- PVC Mini Statue "Bucket"
- Stickers
- Keychain
- Map Poster

REANIMAL will come to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2. 
 
- Links & Info -  
Website: https://reanimal.thqnordic.com
Steam: https://thqn.net/re-steam
PlayStation: https://thqn.net/re-psn
Xbox: https://thqn.net/re-xbox
